feedback.problem: Given that $‖6u+v‖=11$ and $‖v‖=2$, find the smallest possible value of $‖u‖.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the triangle inequality, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖6u+v‖ & \le ‖6u‖+‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖6u+v‖ & \le 6‖u‖+‖v‖ \\ 11 & \le 6‖u‖+2 \\ 9 & \le 6‖u‖ \\ \frac{3}{2} & \le ‖u‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $‖u‖$ is $\frac{3}{2}.$
